phases.description: THEO waits at the open window, looking toward MARA off frame-right
a heavy thump is heard off screen and THEO looks down at the ticket now lying on the counter
THEO holds his look down at the ticket

questions.question: Viewer reads: the ticket is ready: the thump is the stamp - carried by: THEO
0-1s SETUP: does this happen on screen - THEO waits at the open window, looking toward MARA off frame-right?
1-2.5s ACTION: does this happen on screen - a heavy thump is heard off screen and THEO looks down at the ticket now lying on the counter?
2.5-3s HOLD: does this happen on screen - THEO holds his look down at the ticket?
Happens exactly once (not repeated or looped): looks down at the ticket
THEO: does the face/body read as held breath (restrained)? Must NOT read as: disappointment.
Planned size CLOSE, EYE_LEVEL, STATIC: does the take match?

First frame matches state SC05_g2: Continues from the previous shot: MARA seated on her stool behind the counter, frame-right; THEO at the window, frame-left; the shutter: up; the jar: on its side on the counter, empty; the coins: in neat stacks on the counter.

Last frame matches state SC05_g3: Continues from the previous shot: MARA seated on her stool behind the counter, frame-right; THEO at the window, frame-left; the shutter: up; the jar: on its side on the counter, empty; the coins: in neat stacks on the counter; the ticket: lying on the counter.
Identity, wardrobe, set and light stable; no morphing, extra limbs, text artefacts or flicker.
Motion is physically plausible and smooth (full clip, not stills).
Is the place where MARA stands kept out of frame (never shown empty), and do THEO's eyes go just past the lens to frame-right?
Does THEO look at counter and never into the lens?
Do MARA and THEO stay on their own sides (clerk booth (staff side) / public hall (customer side)) the whole clip?

instructions: Fill checks[] (result, severity on FAIL, level, evidence, reviewer human:<id>), then `film.py review --film DIR --ingest FILE`. Leave a group UNASSESSED if you did not look. Questions with an id (REL_*) need a short answer in the group check's answers{id: text}; without it the take cannot be ACCEPTED.
